name: Thin Mint GSC
summary: **Thin Mint GSC** is a [[kind:cut|phenotype]] of [[gsc|GSC]] and one of its two most widely distributed cuts, alongside [[platinum-gsc|Platinum GSC]]. It placed as a finalist at the 2014 Seattle Cannabis Cup. Some accounts dispute the standard [[og-kush|OG Kush]] and [[f1-durban|F1 Durban]] story for this line, tracing it instead to an earlier Cherry Pie x Chemdawg cross.
